spec.text: Image 1 is the approved couple; image 2 is the man's casual model sheet. Create a FACE REFERENCE SHEET of the man on the left of image 1: three large head-and-shoulders views of the SAME face side by side at the same scale - front view, three-quarter view, side profile - each head filling most of the canvas height. Copy his face from image 1 exactly: black rectangular glasses with thick frames, round dark eyes behind them, short thick black eyebrows, a small rounded nose, a small closed-mouth friendly smile, rounded cheeks with soft pink blush, slightly rounded jaw, short swept black hair with soft tufts, ears visible. He wears the navy overshirt over a white crewneck from image 2. Sculpted matte clay with painted gouache texture, soft even studio light, plain warm ivory background. No text, no labels, no extra people.
